data.description: An ijiraq can level an icy stare at a creature within 30 feet. That creature takes a -20 penalty on Perception checks and Survival checks for 24 hours (Fortitude DC %1 negates). An ijiraq can use this ability while in the shape of an elk.
data.name: Disorienting Gaze
